messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — ACME Corp renewal in ~45 days and health score dropped to AMBER after last week's inactivity. Onboarding stalled at API keys step. Need a short save plan before renewal ops flags them. :warning:
Devin: Got it. Do we have usage / seat metrics?
Maria: Low usage on embeddings and reranking routes, 2 active devs, 1 POC workspace. Renewal owner mentioned concerns about cost vs latency.
Ash: Suggest we propose a 'lite' downgrade option + targeted enablement session. Offer 2-week pilot of batching + cache settings to show cost impact. :thinking_face:
Ravi: I can run a quick cost projection. If we cut qps and enable prefix caching we should show ~30% token cost reduction. Need their typical seq len and QPS — Maria do you have that?
Maria: Shared usage snapshot in #cs-data earlier, but TL;DR: avg seq len 512, 40 reqs/min peak. I'll paste snippet for Devin to craft the outreach.
Maria: ```Hey <customer_champion>, saw your trial API keys weren't fully configured — can we do a 30-min call to finish onboarding and run a quick cost/latency tune? We can show potential savings and roadmap for full rollout. Available slots: Tue/Wed 9-11am PT.```
Devin: Nice. I'll send with subject "Quick onboarding tune + cost snapshot" and include a small incentive (1 month of lite credits).
Ash: For the save plan steps: 1) Schedule 30m tune (enable batching, kv caching), 2) Run cost baseline, 3) Offer downgrade path with clear tradeoffs, 4) Capture feedback & success metrics. I'll drop a checklist.
OnboardBot: Reminder created — "ACME onboarding tune" scheduled draft for Tue 10:00am PT.
Ravi: Sending cost projection now -> attaching in thread. (short summary: projected -28% tokens with caching, -12% latency).
Maria: Excellent. Two asks: (1) Devin please send outreach before EOD today; (2) Ash, can you prepare a 15-min enablement deck focused on low-effort wins?
Devin: On it, sending now.
Ash: Will prepare 15-slide deck with before/after numbers and a short demo.
Maria: Also let's capture their reason for churn risk in a quick form. Use this one: https://forms.gle/example (one-question: "What's your biggest blocker right now?"). We'll paste link in outreach.
Ravi: If they ask about downgrade, recommend the "Lite" plan sample config:

```
model: rwd-medium
max_tokens: 1024
quantize: int8
batching: enabled
cache: prefix-kv
```

and a note on feature differences.
Devin: Outreach sent. I'll ping here once they reply. :rocket:
Maria: Thanks team — if reply goes cold in 48h we escalate to renewal ops. Marking action items in the CS ticket. :white_check_mark:
Devin: Reply received — champion available Wed 10am. Adding calendar invite now.
Maria: Great, keep updates here."
